create.name: Adhyatma Vidya Mandir (Tattvatirtha)
create.bio:
Adhyatma Vidya Mandir is a Vedanta ashram on Shilaj Road in Thaltej, on the western side of Ahmedabad, whose campus is known as Tattvatirtha. It was registered as a public trust in 1983 around the teaching of Swami Viditatmananda Saraswati, a disciple of Swami Dayananda Saraswati, and belongs to the Arsha Vidya line, which traces itself through Swami Chinmayananda and Dayananda back to Adi Shankara. Swami Viditatmananda chairs it and remains its principal teacher, with several other sannyasi teachers of the tradition.

The core of the ashram's life is regular Vedanta classes, given in Gujarati and English at the ashram and around the city, on the Bhagavad Gita, the Upanishads and the Brahma Sutras with Shankara's commentaries. Twice a year it holds residential retreats of eight to ten days that combine three talks a day with meditation, chanting, satsang and kirtan, and each year Swamiji gives week-long public lecture series in Ahmedabad, Vadodara, Rajkot and Mumbai. For people studying at home the site sets out a guided study path in three stages, and talks are streamed and archived on its Harih Om YouTube channel and as podcasts.

courses.title: Vedanta classes with Swami Viditatmananda
courses.description: Ongoing classes at the ashram and at venues in Ahmedabad, in Gujarati and English, working line by line through a text with Shankara's commentary. Current texts include the Brahma Sutras and the Bhagavad Gita.

courses.title: Residential Vedanta retreats
courses.description: Retreats of eight to ten days held twice a year at the ashram, with three talks a day on a Vedanta text, morning puja, meditation, evening chanting, and satsang and kirtan at night. Dates are announced by the ashram.

courses.title: Jnana Yajna lecture series
courses.description: Public talk series of a week or more given each year in Ahmedabad and other Gujarat cities and Mumbai: an Upanishad or short Vedanta text in the mornings and the Bhagavad Gita in the evenings, with time for questions.

free_resources.title: Guided Vedanta Study
free_resources.description: A self-study path drawn from the ashram's books and recorded lecture series, arranged in beginner, intermediate and advanced stages in Gujarati and English, so that a student can move from the Tattvabodha and Gita overview to the major Upanishads in order.
